title: Morning
notes: Every morning after Monday. Claude's draft, built on Monday's three choices.
Once you have a morning line, following it is how a morning is kept. After three kept mornings the routine has formed and collapses into one tap: "Run my morning." (Outline, stage 3.)
Escape is still always on the menu.

then: notice:You slept badly. Tonight's encounter starts with more Pull.

text: The alarm sounds farther away than it is. Last night is still in your head.
6:30. The alarm. The phone, lit, a foot from your head.
6:30. You know how this goes now. You don't have to decide it.

then: proof:purpose:Kept the morning on a workday.

choices.label: Follow the morning line.
result: You do it the way you set it up. It's smaller than it sounds and it takes less than you'd think.

choices.label: Get up.
result: Cold floor. You have time for coffee.

choices.label: Check the phone. Just a minute.
result: It isn't a minute. It's forty. Then it's 7:10.
choices.record: 40 minutes on the phone before getting up.

choices.label: Go get the phone from the kitchen. Just a minute.
result: You walk past the coffee maker to get it. It isn't a minute. It's forty. Then it's 7:10.
choices.record: 40 minutes on the phone before getting up.

choices.label: Snooze.
result: Nine more minutes. Then nine more. Less morning, no more rest.
